title: Recovered craft cannot be flown because consciousness pilots them

tellings.quote: they they they obviously ran into a major problem uh that they weren't able to Pilot the craft because it's Consciousness that Pilots the craft

plain: Those trying to reverse engineer recovered alien craft, that is, take them apart to learn how they work, are said to have hit a major problem: they could not fly them, because "it's consciousness that pilots the craft". A guest named Dan Sheehan tells Michels this as something he was told, which would mean the craft respond to a mind rather than to controls.
